chapter: New York, Bostic and Dizzy Gillespie
title: Joining the New York union local
summary: He explains he was already in the Philadelphia union and joined the New York local quickly through a connection.

story.theme_name: The musicians' union: cards, locals, and the Black-white merger
story.community_name: The musicians' union: cards, scale and the black-white merger

blocks.x: Did you join the union? Did you have to join the union?

I’d already joined the union in Philly, but yeah, you had to join the New York local. I knew somebody who knew somebody. So I was able to do it without waiting, because usually you have to wait a month or so before you could wait. But while you’re waiting, you can’t work. I knew somebody. I remember I went there. I had to do the same thing here, but I knew somebody here and I could work right away. That’s kind of antiquated. You got to wait a month before you can work. I don’t understand that. Yeah, I was a member of Philadelphia, New York, and here. I’m a member here and New York. Philadelphia, I don’t think I’m a member anymore. I haven’t been there so long.
